method.sampling: One warm Codex in-app browser session on production v218. One visit per artist at 1265 CSS px, plus one Billlie visit at 375 CSS px.
method.firstControl: Each artist uses the video selector from its home entry in apps/idol-site/tests/fixtures/mixed-media-routes.cjs. lastMissingMs and firstSeenMs bracket the first observed actionable control in that selection. firstSeenMs is its observation upper bound. The fixture can select a hero link, an MV card or a song link inside a release feature. Other links outside the selection are outside the timing scope. Click, image decode and video start are separate observations.
method.catalog: catalogAtCard and catalogAfter are cumulative Resource Timing samples for catalog requests completed by the observation time. A request in flight is absent until it completes. These are not whole-page network totals.
method.secondObservation: Approximately 350 ms after firstSeenMs, with the actual observation time in atSampleMs.
method.timingUnits: Milliseconds relative to the page performance time origin. For each completed request, time to first byte = response minus request (responseStart minus requestStart).
method.byteFields: transfer, encoded and decoded are transferSize, encodedBodySize and decodedBodySize in bytes.
method.keyboard: focus records actual Tab steps classified by the selected home video and album controls. The first mv and first album step per visit describe that pair. Other focus targets are not classified in these rows. The recorded name identifies a control and can differ from its accessible name.

scopeReview.basis: Separate v218 structural review of all 51 home routes using the checked-in catalog and the actual React or native renderer. DOM precedence and work or release identity were checked locally. The timing and Tab steps in rows belong solely to the original browser selections.
scopeReview.earlierStage: izna presents the METRONOME dance-performance card before the selected DUMB HOT! MV card.
